Documents: the false sentence 'by hand or in the panel between calls there is no row and the trail check does not see it' was replaced in SECURITY.md, plugins/audit/README.md, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md and CHANGELOG.md with: no row (sn20 by hand, sn4 in the panel); the trail check warns that the config has changed since the last row that recorded it whenever that row recorded the config as it stood before the switch-off (a panel save, or an edit-tool or command write of the config made while on), with a later call or none (sn23); it says nothing when no row ever recorded the config (sn23b with other rows, sn20 with none). README and CHANGELOG cite sn23 without the 'by hand and in the panel' qualifier. SECURITY.md's other 'does not see it' (the MCP write of another tree's config, oq5) is the config hold's and was left. Deviation from the description's wording, on purpose: the documents say 'says nothing when no row ever recorded the config', not 'only when', because 'only' is false when the last config row recorded the bytes the switch-off restores (a last-will row recorded the config off, a hand switch-on with no row, a hand switch-off back to the same bytes: verify compares bytes, _journal_io.verify's 'elif now != state'), and the warning half is worded 'whenever that row recorded the config as it stood before the switch-off' for the same reason. Panel route, from the sn23 run: a panel save made while on writes its own config row (recorded == 1); a panel save that switches the journal off writes none and then draws the warning, so 'in the panel ... no row' stays true. Edit lane: it keeps a reading only for a write of the config itself (journal-writes.py pre_cache: rel == CONFIG_REL) and removes it at its own call site (post_rows, the _drop_reading after own =); sn24's edit-tool row covers it.
